scenario_name: PDP8 / Vietnam NDC power-capacity pathway (Quy hoạch điện VIII)
intro: As part of Mekong Commercial Bank's climate transition assessment, we have reviewed {{borrower}}'s generation-capacity mix against Vietnam's Power Development Plan VIII (Quy hoạch điện VIII) and Paris-aligned pathways. Our analysis indicates {{alignment_gap}}, meaning the financed capacity is not yet aligned with the low-carbon transition.
action_1: Data request: please provide asset-level generation-capacity data (operating and pipeline, by technology and commissioning year) ahead of the next reporting cycle so MCB can refine this assessment.
action_2: Transition-plan ask: please share a Board-approved transition plan (kế hoạch chuyển dịch) setting out coal phase-down and renewable build-out milestones consistent with PDP8 and a 2050 net-zero trajectory.
action_3: Covenant trigger: absent a credible transition plan, MCB may apply sustainability-linked covenants or sector exposure limits (giới hạn tín dụng theo ngành) at the next credit review.

scenario_name: PDP8 / Vietnam NDC vehicle technology-share pathway
intro: As part of Mekong Commercial Bank's climate transition assessment, we have compared {{borrower}}'s vehicle technology mix (electric, hybrid, internal combustion) against Vietnam's Paris-aligned market-share pathway to 2030. Our analysis indicates {{alignment_gap}}, driven mainly by a slow shift toward electrified drivetrains.
action_1: Data request: please provide production-volume and order-book data by drivetrain technology (electric, hybrid, ICE) for the next reporting cycle.
action_2: Transition-plan ask: please share an electrification roadmap (lộ trình điện khí hóa) with model-launch and capacity-conversion milestones consistent with a 2030 low-carbon market-share trajectory.
action_3: Covenant trigger: MCB may link future financing terms to demonstrable progress on electrified-vehicle share, or apply sector exposure limits at the next credit review.

intro: As part of Mekong Commercial Bank's climate transition assessment, we have benchmarked {{borrower}}'s clinker and cement emission intensity against a Sectoral Decarbonisation Approach (SDA) pathway. Our analysis indicates {{alignment_gap}}, meaning emission intensity is above the level required for a Paris-aligned trajectory.
action_1: Data request: please provide plant-level production and CO2 emission-intensity data (tCO2 per tonne of cementitious product) for the next reporting cycle.
action_2: Transition-plan ask: please share a decarbonisation plan covering clinker-substitution, alternative fuels, and energy-efficiency measures consistent with the SDA emission-intensity pathway.
action_3: Covenant trigger: absent a credible decarbonisation plan, MCB may apply sustainability-linked covenants tied to emission-intensity reduction or revise sector exposure limits at the next credit review.

intro: As part of Mekong Commercial Bank's climate transition assessment, we have benchmarked {{borrower}}'s crude-steel emission intensity against a Sectoral Decarbonisation Approach (SDA) pathway. action_3: Covenant trigger: absent a credible decarbonisation plan, MCB may apply sustainability-linked covenants tied to emission-intensity reduction or revise sector exposure limits at the next credit review.
